items.name: Black Leather Wallet
items.description: Found near the checkout counter. Has a few cards inside and some loose change. Corners are a little worn.
items.additionalDetails: Small scratch on the front flap, embossed initials 'R.K.'

items.name: AirPods Pro Case
items.description: White charging case only, no earbuds inside. Was sitting on a reading table for a while before someone turned it in.
items.additionalDetails: Small dent on one corner, no engraving.

items.name: Blue Backpack
items.description: Navy blue backpack with a laptop sleeve and a keychain of a small robot hanging from the front zipper.
items.additionalDetails: Contains a charger and a marked-up notebook. Zipper pull is broken on the small pocket.

items.name: Student ID Card
items.description: Found tucked between vending machine and the wall. Card looks recently issued, still has that glossy shine.
items.additionalDetails: Name partially visible, batch year printed as 2027.

items.name: Scientific Calculator
items.description: Left behind after an evening class. Has a cracked screen protector and a rubber cover that's peeling at one edge.
items.additionalDetails: Sticker with initials 'S.M.' on the back.

items.name: Steel Water Bottle
items.description: Insulated steel bottle left on the bleachers after practice. Still had cold water inside when it was picked up.
items.additionalDetails: Dent on the base, stickers of a mountain trail brand.

items.name: Hostel Room Keys
items.description: Set of three keys on a red carabiner clip, including a room key and what looks like a cupboard key.
items.additionalDetails: One key has a chipped plastic head.

items.name: USB-C Charger Brick
items.description: 30W charger left plugged into an outlet near the back row of seats. No cable attached.

items.name: Spiral Notebook
items.description: Green spiral notebook full of handwritten chemistry notes, probably from this semester's lab sessions.
items.additionalDetails: Cover has a doodled sun on the front.

items.name: Wired Earphones
items.description: Tangled pair of wired earphones found under a bench, one ear tip missing.

items.name: Denim Jacket
items.description: Light-wash denim jacket, size M, left hanging over a chair after a group project session.
items.additionalDetails: Small enamel pin on the left collar.

items.name: Prescription Glasses
items.description: Found folded on top of a printer. Thin gold frames with clear lenses, kept in a soft case nearby.

items.name: Semester Fee Receipt Folder
items.description: Clear plastic folder with fee receipts and a photocopy of an admission letter inside.
items.additionalDetails: Folder has a small tear on the top edge.

items.name: Grey Duffel Bag
items.description: Gym duffel bag found near the equipment room, contains a towel and a spare pair of shoes.

items.name: Silver Analog Watch
items.description: Simple silver-strap analog watch, already claimed by its owner after a quick verification chat.
